title: Name a small function
summary: Groovy: Name a small function. Call twice(7).
introduction: A closure is a block of reusable code. The arrow separates inputs from steps.
learningObjectives: Name a small function with Groovy

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Groovy. Save each example as lesson.groovy and run groovy lesson.groovy.

blocks.title: Name a small function
blocks.code:
def twice = { n -> n * 2 }
println twice(4)

blocks.text: The closure input n receives 4. Its last expression returns 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The last expression is the closure result.
